title: Nationaal Scholierenonderzoek 1994 - NSO'94
descriptions: Survey among pupils of secondary schools with a great number of detailed questions about their living conditions, opinions and attitudes. Living conditions at school and at home / income / money spending / dealing with money / time spending / education / independence / political preference / religious conviction / health / well-being / type of school / schoolyear / age at which respondent came to the Netherlands / Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ politics/ religion/ consumption of durables. The data- and documentation files of this dataset can be downloaded via the option Data Files.
